Which statements about graphite are correct?
1
Each carbon atom is covalently bonded to four other carbon atoms.
2
Graphite is an electrical conductor because it contains ions that are free to move.
3
Graphite is used as a lubricant because it has layers that slide over each other.
A
1 and 2
B
1 only
C
2 and 3
D
3 only
subject: Chemistry
